name: Advice Slip
description: Advice Slip is a free public API that returns random advice slips and supports search by keyword. Responses are available in JSON or XML, and no authentication is required.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public endpoints accept unauthenticated GET requests.

example.response_snippet: {"slip":{"id":1,"advice":"Remember that spiders are more afraid of you, than you are of them."}}

use_cases: look up an advice slip by id
